product_block: The product is the Shnuggle Toddler Bath, copied exactly from reference image 1 (real product photo) and reference image 2 (six real views of the same tub): a white plastic toddler bath tub with a smooth matte finish, an egg-shaped rounded body about 36 cm tall on a 39 x 54 cm base, a wide rolled rim that rises higher at the back, a light grey foam backrest panel inside the back wall with a faint embossed shnuggle logo, a small embossed MAX fill-line mark low on the inside wall, a light grey oval logo badge on the front outside reading only the lowercase word shnuggle (no registered mark, no other text), a smooth, plain, matte white contoured inside floor with a single smooth raised oval seat bump shaped like a soft rounded pillow (one oval, not two lobes) (no dots, no holes, no circles, no pattern anywhere on the tub), and small light grey foot pads under the base. Copy its shape, proportions, colours, logo badge and backrest exactly; the tub is shown alone and stays empty and dry.
nothing_added: Do not add anything to the product or around it: no plug, no knob, no drain stopper, no handle, no seat insert, no water, no bubbles, no toys, no towel, no bottles, no stickers, no dots, holes or printed pattern, no extra text or labels. No people, no hands, no children. Nothing else at any edge of the frame.
look: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 smartphone photo of a real home bathroom: pale powder-blue square wall tiles with white grout, light grey stone floor tiles, white fixtures and chrome taps. Bright soft natural daylight from a window, neutral white balance, clean and bright, no yellow or warm cast, no dark or moody shadows, sharp focus on the tub.
